subject: Sandbox support request — connector dependency causing PoC stall
messages:
From: Alex Torres <atorres@cloudkrafter.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Kelly Ng <kng@cloudkrafter.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Blocker: on-prem connector failing — PoC timeline at risk

Sean —

Quick summary: our on-prem connector to the customer vault is intermittently failing during the handshake, which causes the sync job to return 502s and stalls the demo pipeline. Engineering dug in and attached the logs (kb-logs.tar.gz) and one screenshot of the 502.

Because of this, our internal teams cannot complete the integration tasks needed to finish the PoC by Dec 5. We have a hard stakeholder demo on Dec 7 and we expect to need an extra 10–14 calendar days to finish the connector work and re-run validation.

Can Redwood offer a small sandbox credit top-up and a two-week extension on the PoC window so we can finish the integration and then push to the demo? The sandbox is nearly exhausted because of repeated repro runs; a short credit bridge would let us avoid starting over.

What would you need from us to approve this? We can share the log bundle, schedule an engineer pairing session, or provide a short runbook of the failing endpoints.

Thanks — appreciate any quick help.

— Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Integrations | CloudKrafter
atorres@cloudkrafter.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@cloudkrafter.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Blocker: on-prem connector failing — PoC timeline at risk

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear summary and for attaching the logs. Sorry to hear that hit right before the demo run. We should be able to help without you having to restart the PoC.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- Can your eng lead join a 1-hour pairing session with one of our solutions engineers this week? We can slot a deep-dive and try to reproduce against a mirrored setup.
- Please paste the minimal failing curl + response in the shared Drive folder you linked (or just reply with the endpoint and error snippet).
- I will submit a short request for a sandbox token top-up and a 14-day PoC extension to our approvals queue; Ben (solutions) and Avery (sales manager) are looped for approval and scope.

If you send the exact times your team can pair, I’ll pull in an SE and prioritize the credit ask. We usually approve small top-ups for infra blockers like this, but I’ll confirm the amount after Ben reviews the logs.

On the logistics side, if you prefer a hard date extension rather than a token-based top-up we can do that too — whatever helps preserve the demo momentum.

Best,

Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
(650) 555-2741

If you can approve a 100k-token sandbox top-up and a 14-day extension we’ll be able to complete the work and validate the flow ahead of the Dec 7 stakeholder demo. If you need a smaller amount first we can try that too; the bulk of our spend is from repeated repro attempts.

Appreciate it — Alex

We reviewed the logs and the runbook. Given this is an integration-level issue and the PoC demo is time-boxed, we’ll approve a one-time sandbox credit top-up for 100,000 tokens and extend the PoC window by 14 calendar days.

Action items we’ve created:
- Billing: create billing adjustment ticket BILL-789 (Avery, please create and attach the credit memo).
- SE pairing: Sean to schedule the pairing session with CloudKrafter for either Nov 26 or Dec 1; if the pairing happens on Dec 1 we’ll still hold the extension starting Dec 5.
- Follow-up: Alex to confirm the pairing time and drop any additional traces.
